route_control.claim: Casson's closed form and the generic quadrature agree at this operating point, so a family-to-family force difference is a difference between FITS and not between numerical routes.

plateau_null.claim: A Newtonian fluid AT the Casson plateau reproduces the Casson force to about the yield term, so the needle is reading the high-rate plateau and essentially nothing else. The 30 % is therefore a disagreement between plateaux, not a difference in what the geometry samples.

viscosity_ladder.claim: The families disagree across the whole MEASURED range, by more at the bottom of the envelope than at the needle. The 30 % is a misfit between two differently-shaped fits to the same 16 points, not an artefact of reading them past the data.

matched_plateau_null.claim: Cross with its plateau set to Casson's, keeping all its other fitted parameters, collapses the difference into the yield band. So at the needle the plateau IS what is being read, and the 30 % is a disagreement about its value.
